name: Vandal
summary: Hyper-aggressive skirmisher built around heat management, supercharged slides, and double-jump repositioning. The pick for players who want to start fights on their own terms.

prime.name: Amplify
prime.desc: Overdrive state that reduces heat generation and increases movement speed and weapon dexterity for its duration.

tactical.name: Disruptor
tactical.desc: Arm cannon that fires a disrupting projectile to break up entrenched enemies.

traits: Microjets — secondary jump for vertical repositioning
Supercharged slides — extended, faster slide mechanics
tips: Amplify's reduced heat generation means you can run hot weapons harder mid-fight — pop it before committing, not after.
Microjets + slide chains let you cross open exfil sightlines that other shells have to route around.
You have no sustain in your kit: pair with a Triage in trios, or stack NuCaloric medical unlocks when soloing.

sources.title: GameSpot — All Runner Shells And Their Abilities

name: Destroyer
summary: Straightforward combat shell: shoulder-mounted ordnance, a deployable barricade, and thrusters. Strong in declared fights, weaker at disengaging.

prime.name: Search & Destroy
prime.desc: Shoulder-mounted pods fire heat-seeking missiles at locked targets.

tactical.name: Riot Barricade
tactical.desc: Deployable energy shield that blocks incoming damage — instant hard cover for revives and plant/hack interactions.

tips: Missiles force enemies out of cover even when they don't kill — treat the Prime as a flushing tool for your crew.
Drop Riot Barricade perpendicular to a doorway to revive teammates through it safely.
UESC units and Cryo Archive lockdown bosses are vulnerable to missile volleys at openers.

sources.title: GameSpot — All Runner Shells And Their Abilities

name: Recon
summary: Wins fights before they start by knowing where everyone is. Sonar pulses, tracker drones, and warning pings make Recon the backbone of cautious, high-value crews.

prime.name: Echo Pulse
prime.desc: Emits sonar pulses that detect and reveal nearby hostiles.

tactical.name: Tracker Drones
tactical.desc: Deployable drones that explode in proximity to enemies, causing overheating.

traits: Ping warnings when enemies are detected nearby
Enemies that break your shield leave holographic footstep trails
tips: Echo Pulse before any locked-room or contract interaction — third-partying crews show up exactly then.
Tracker drones double as area denial on exfil consoles during the countdown.
Footstep trails after a shield break turn a lost duel into intel for your crew — call the direction immediately.

sources.title: GameSpot — All Runner Shells And Their Abilities

name: Assassin
summary: The hardest Runner to track. Smoke fields plus active camouflage — and a passive that re-cloaks you inside smoke — make Assassin the premier flanker and escape artist.

prime.name: Smoke Field
prime.desc: Deploys a smoke disc creating a concealing field.

tactical.name: Active Camouflage
tactical.desc: Cloaks the Runner, breaking visual tracking.

traits: Camo automatically activates when entering smoke
Shadow Dive — airborne slam that negates fall damage
tips: Smoke + auto-camo is your engage AND your disengage — hold the tactical for whichever you didn't use.
Shadow Dive from high ground straight onto loot lets you skip whole contested staircases.
Camo shimmers when you sprint; walk the last 10 meters of a flank.

sources.title: GamesRadar — Marathon characters and Runner Shell tier list

name: Triage
summary: The dedicated support shell. Ranged revives, med drones, and consumable sharing keep trios running deep into a raid economy where every death costs gear.

prime.name: Remote Revive / EMP
prime.desc: Revive a downed ally at range, or use the charge offensively to EMP hostiles.

tactical.name: Med Drones
tactical.desc: Drones that regenerate ally health and shields.

tips: The Prime is a genuine choice each charge: a ranged revive mid-fight is usually worth more than the EMP — but EMP wins ability-dependent matchups like Destroyer barricade pushes.
Med drones pre-deployed at an exfil point turn the extraction timer into a healing window.
In duos/trios, Shareware means you carry the patch kits and distribute on demand — centralize the med economy.

sources.title: GameSpot — All Runner Shells And Their Abilities

name: Thief
summary: Built to get rich: a grapple for verticality, an X-ray visor that highlights the best loot and hostiles, and a drone that can literally steal from other Runners.

prime.name: Pickpocket Drone
prime.desc: Drone that locates enemies and can steal loot from other Runners.

tactical.name: Grapple Hook
tactical.desc: Rapidly gain height or cross gaps.

traits: X-ray visor — highlights hostiles and high-value loot
Improved weapon handling scaled by backpack contents
tips: Grapple routes over the Pinwheel (Outpost) and Cryo Archive catwalks skip clearance-gated corridors entirely.
The handling-scales-with-loot trait means Thief gets stronger the greedier you play — lean into it, then leave early.
Pickpocket Drone on a camping squad at exfil is the safest robbery in the game.

sources.title: GamesRadar — Marathon characters and Runner Shell tier list

name: Rook
summary: Not a class so much as a mode: drop solo into an ongoing match with no loadout and nothing to lose. Pure evasion, recovery, and bankroll rebuilding.

prime.desc: Rook deploys without a standard ability loadout.

tactical.desc: Rook deploys without a standard ability loadout.

traits: Risks nothing on death — no stash loss
Can stabilize items with Matter Fixatives
Blends in with AI bot units
restrictions: Cannot progress faction contracts while deployed as Rook.
tips: Rook is the correct answer to a wiped bankroll — rebuild credits with zero downside, then switch back.
Blending with AI bots is real concealment: stop sprinting and walk patrol-like paths near UESC groups.
Because faction contracts don't progress, never run Rook when you're rep-capped on time, not credits.

name: Sentinel
role: Defensive Specialist — area control (NEW in Season 2)
summary: Season 2's new shell. Shapes fights before enemies commit: an anti-ordnance platform, immobilizing snare mines, and short-range motion intel make Sentinel the king of holding rooms and protecting exfils.

prime.name: Defender System
prime.desc: Deploys an automated platform that harmlessly neutralizes incoming grenades and missiles, and boosts weapon stability and reload speed for nearby crewmates.

tactical.name: Snare Mine
tactical.desc: Proximity-triggered mine that spreads an immobilizing effect.

traits: Prey Tracker — short-range motion detection revealing moving enemies on radar
Castle Doctrine — faster SMG/pistol/shotgun readiness based on nearby hostiles; taking splash damage triggers temporary stat buffs
tips: Defender System hard-counters Destroyer missiles and grenade spam — drop it on the exfil pad during the countdown.
Snare Mines on the two most likely entry doors, then fight from the third angle. You choose where the fight happens.
Castle Doctrine favors CQC secondaries: keep a shotgun or SMG even on long-range loadouts.
